name: pdfluent-pdf
description: PDFluent PDF API as MCP tools: merge, split, compress, redact, fill forms, convert, PDF/A, OCR and barcodes. Documents are sent to api.pdfluent.com; calls are paid in prepaid credits.

api_key.title: PDFluent API key
api_key.description: Create a key in the PDFluent console at pdfluent.com. It is sent to api.pdfluent.com as the x-api-key header and stored in your system keychain.
